title: The 2027 Sulphur Dioxide Order: which coal boilers its schedule lists
setting: A fictional environment ministry's air quality directorate in an unnamed coal-producing country with a register of permitted coal boilers in a Northern Priority Area: the country, its bodies, the firms, the contractors and the people are fictional, and every record is synthetic.
